title: Improve resource viewer playback and text controls
changes: Show PCM, CGB and sequence playback positions and a sequence playhead, preserving the active selector focus when the reader clicks Play.
Provide shared language pin and command visibility across text views, plus sprite playback from the selected frame with optional looping and settings preserved when the sprite changes.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-controls-repo-final-a75dspzj checked playback progress, loops, physical pointer focus, text settings and sprite changes using the permanent interaction test. Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-controls-eur-yl_quy7d exercised the same controls with real Web Audio; dataset and prior local page were protected.

Initial controls test ek5ebqhq reached a blank browser page before navigation; repo test wq4wiu4z could not create a long Unix socket, diagnosed by hcb_7yrw. Both test setup issues were corrected before the passing units.
Unit rom-data-viewer-controls-cleanup-s43t_yno reran the interaction test and checked that a failed browser setup terminates its process and removes the temporary link.
limitations: Physical audio output and Windows were not tested. The generated local page preserves the previously verified file inspector while the large-JSON worker prototype remains suspended and unverified in the template.
